defs.def: typical, usual or ordinary; what you would expect 典型的；正常的；一般的

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.
ex.t: 这种无可比拟的价格优势鼓励我去尝试了几十种我平时绝不会考虑购买的书籍。

ex.s: At worst, you will have refreshed and deepened your knowledge of the rules you normally apply, so that you can be even more effective next time.
ex.t: 与愉悦相关的大脑部分在我们发现美的事物时会被激活。
对他们来说，这只是正常的。

ex.s: At the side of roads, behind school playgrounds and on all kinds of unloved pieces of land across towns and cities, tiny forests barely the size of tennis courts are appearing, making a great place for both wildlife and local people who may not normally have easy access to nature.
ex.t: 在路边、学校操场后面以及城镇和城市中各种无人问津的土地上，只有网球场地大小的小森林正在出现，为野生动物和通常不容易接触到大自然的当地居民创造了一个绝佳场所。

ex.s: The participants followed suit, taking more food than they normally would have.
ex.t: 参与者们纷纷效仿，吃的食物比平时多得多。

ex.s: The parents were asked to interact with their children as they normally would, and about half of children in the study played with puzzles at one time.
ex.t: 父母被要求像往常一样与孩子互动，研究中约有一半的孩子在某个时候玩过拼图。

ex.s: Normally, towns use rock salt to de-ice streets.
ex.t: 通常，城镇使用岩盐来为街道除冰。

ex.s: The police _____52_____ and the motorway ran normally again.
ex.t: 我简直不敢相信我的   _____53_____ 结果没有人受重伤，但结果本来可能   _____54_____ 更糟。Don那天晚上得到了一个特殊的   _____55_____ ——我不想让它以为我在生它的气。

ex.s: Conventional air pollution monitors are normally fixed on lampposts at about nine feet in the air.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，地面附近的污染水平比机构记录高度处的污染水平高出约三分之二。

ex.s: C．By bringing the broken﹣down ecosystems back to normal．
ex.t: C．具有商业价值的物种主导其他物种。

ex.s: Meanwhile, with her parents' help, Moore is generally able to live a normal teenage life.
ex.t: 随着CanCandy的成功，摩尔作为年轻企业家的信誉也在不断提高。

ex.s: On top of this, she must make a choice between continuing the normal life of a San Francisco teen and stepping up to the throne.
ex.t: 除此之外，她还必须在继续一个旧金山青少年的正常生活和登上王位之间做出选择。

ex.s: In 2017, representatives from Peking University, Tsinghua University, Nankai University and Yunnan Normal University gathered to commemorate the 80th anniversary of its founding.
ex.t: 2017年，来自北京大学、清华大学、南开大学和云南师范大学的代表齐聚一堂，纪念其成立80周年。

ex.s: And as times change, old words become as normal to young people as the new ones are to me.
ex.t: 随着时代的变化，旧词对年轻人来说就像新词对我来说一样平常。

ex.s: A year after the war ended, the three universities moved back to their original locations and resumed their normal activities.
ex.t: 战争结束一年后，三所大学搬回了原来的地址，恢复了正常的活动。

ex.s: What was left behind in Kunming became today’s Yunnan Normal University.
ex.t: 留在昆明的那部分成为了今天的云南师范大学。

defs.def: not suffering from any mental disorder 精神正常的；意识健全的

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 那么为什么我们这么多人讨厌开放式办公室呢？
